rubrics.justification: Description is consistent with a very poor-quality early blastocyst/0DD, noting minimal expansion and absent/degenerative ICM and TE. It is accurate overall, though somewhat stronger than image-only certainty and omits zona pellucida detail.

Integrates age, ovarian reserve, sperm, endometrium, lifestyle, and prior IVF outcomes well, and relates them to the unexpectedly poor embryo quality. Could further nuance the diagnosis and prior cycle context.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent: severe morphology drives prognosis despite favorable patient factors. Slight overstatement in calling the embryo definitively non-viable lowers the score.

Use of Gardner grading and emphasis on poor prognosis are aligned with IVF practice, but stating the embryo is essentially non-viable/0-1% is somewhat stronger than guideline-based caution, since morphology alone cannot prove non-viability.
The response begins recommendations but is truncated before providing clear transfer or future-cycle planning, so practical next steps are largely missing.
